While our SPM leads the business charter, you will go deep on the platform layer — owning the core ad\-serving pipeline, campaign management capabilities, and measurement framework that make the entire ads business possible. This is a role for someone who is deeply curious about how ads platforms work from the ground up, is comfortable getting into technical depth with engineers, and wants to build scalable systems that enable advertisers to run, measure, and optimise their campaigns on Nykaa.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Build Core Ads Platform Capabilities
 



 • Own the product roadmap for core ads infrastructure — ad serving, auction mechanics (CPC/CPM/vCPM), pacing, frequency capping, and budget management.
 



 • Define detailed PRDs and technical specifications for platform features, working hand\-in\-hand with Engineering and Adtech architects.
 



 • Ensure the ads platform is robust, scalable, and low\-latency — capable of supporting high ad request volumes with minimal impact on user experience.
 



 2\. Campaign Management \& Advertiser Tooling
 



 • Build and improve self\-serve and managed campaign creation flows — making it easy for brands and agencies to launch, manage, and optimize campaigns on Nykaa.
 



 • Develop advertiser\-facing dashboards and reporting tools that provide clear, actionable visibility into campaign performance.
 



 • Own the ad ops and campaign lifecycle — from trafficking and flight management to delivery pacing and campaign teardown.
 



 3\. Measurement, Attribution \& Reporting
 



 • Build a rigorous, transparent measurement framework — covering impression tracking, click attribution, view\-through attribution, and post\-purchase ROAS.
 



 • Partner with Data Engineering and Analytics to ensure clean data pipelines that feed accurate, real\-time advertiser reporting.
 



 • Identify and reduce attribution blind spots; work with the team to evolve measurement standards as the platform scales.
 



 4\. Quality, Trust \& Platform Integrity
 



 • Build guardrails to ensure ad quality — brand safety, creative compliance, content policies — so the ad experience is trusted by both users and advertisers.
 



 • Instrument the platform with the right logging and alerting to detect delivery anomalies, underspend, or system degradation early.
 



 What We're Looking For
 



 • At least 4 years of Product Management experience in consumer internet, e\-commerce, or ad\-tech.
 



 • Strong interest in and working understanding of ads domain fundamentals — auction theory, ad serving, campaign lifecycles, and performance measurement.
 



 • Technical fluency: comfortable working with backend engineers on system design, API contracts, and data pipeline decisions.
 



 • Analytical mindset with hands\-on experience defining and tracking ads metrics: impressions, CTR, CVR, fill rate, CPM, and ROAS.
 



 • Detail\-oriented executor with excellent documentation skills — able to write tight PRDs and specs that leave no room for ambiguity.
 



 • Academic Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree from a Tier 1 institution, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
 



**Good to Have** 




 • Prior exposure to ad servers, SSPs, DSPs, or programmatic advertising pipelines.
 



 • Experience with ad\-tech tooling such as Google Ad Manager, Xandr, or similar platforms.
 



 • Familiarity with privacy\-safe targeting (contextual, cohort\-based) and signal loss in a cookie\-less environment.
 



**Why Join Us** 




 Nykaa's Ads business is at an early and exciting stage — there is significant greenfield work to be done in building a world\-class retail media platform. As a SPM on the platform team, you'll get to go deep on the foundational building blocks that will power this business for years to come. If you want to understand ads from first principles and ship systems that matter at scale, this is the role for you.

**Senior Product Manager – Platform Efficiency \& COGS**
**About The Role**
 As a Senior Product Manager for Platform Efficiency, you will drive continual “cost to value” alignment by delivering the product features and platform enhancements that ensure durable efficiency of scale. You will sit at the intersection of Product, Engineering, FinOps, and Pricing \- responsible for the architectural efficiency and gross margin health of our global SaaS analytics platform.
   

  

 Sumo Logic processes hundreds of terabytes of data daily. Your mission is to ensure that as we scale, our infrastructure costs stay lean and our platform remains a performant, competitive, and high\-margin engine. You will own the strategy for optimizing data ingestion, storage, networking, and compute costs while simultaneously improving the platform’s performance and reliability.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* COGS Strategy \& Roadmap: Own the end\-to\-end roadmap for platform efficiency. Identify, prioritize, and execute initiatives that reduce cost\-to\-serve without compromising customer experience or SLAs. Own product strategy to focus on customer margins across multiple Sumologic revenue products
* Infrastructure Optimization: Collaborate with Core Platform and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams to optimize resource allocation across Kubernetes, Kafka, and AWS services (S3, DynamoDB, EC2\).
* Cost Observability: Partner with FinOps to ensure internal "Cost Observability" dashboards inform continual efficiency improvements. Use data to identify "hot spots" in our AWS/Cloud infrastructure and drive targeted architectural shifts.
* Product Improvement Lifecycle: Translate complex technical bottlenecks into actionable PRDs. Define "Definition of Done" for efficiency projects, focusing on metrics like Cost per GB Ingested and Cost of Query engine, CPU utilisation of engineering assemblies.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Coordinate across Finance, UX, and Engineering stakeholders to deliver cost optimized solutions that meet the needs of customers as well as the financial goals of the business. Clearly articulate the financial impacts of technical debt and infrastructure modernization to executive stakeholders.
* Vendor \& Cloud Management: Work with cloud providers and 3rd party vendors to optimize licensing, reserved instances, and usage\-based billing models.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Technical Depth: You have a solid understanding of cloud\-native architectures, distributed systems, and microservices. Experience with AWS cost structures and FinOps principles is a major plus.
* Data\-Driven Mindset: You are a power user of data analytics tools and have a strong hold on cost and numbers. You don’t just report data; you find the "why" behind the numbers to drive strategic pivots.
* SaaS Savvy: 5\+ years of PM experience, ideally in a technical platform role within an Enterprise SaaS environment (Log Analytics, Observability, or Cybersecurity).
* Execution Focus: Proven track record of taking high\-level efficiency goals and breaking them down into testable hypotheses and delivered features.
* Communication: Ability to explain the ROI of a "refactoring project" to a non\-technical stakeholder just as clearly as you can discuss API rate\-limiting with a Principal Engineer.


**Pricing Knowledge: Experience with pricing, units of measure, and cost modeling.**
**Technical Toolkit (Nice to Have)**
* Experience with Big Data technologies (Lucene, Parquet, Spark).
* Familiarity with billing and provisioning systems (e.g., Zuora).
* Understanding of OpenTelemetry (OTel) and its impact on data pipeline efficiency.


**Why Join Sumo Logic?**
 You will be working on one of the largest scale data problems in the industry. Your work directly impacts the company’s bottom line and determines our ability to innovate by freeing up capital for new product investments.
   

  

**About Us**
 Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI\-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.
   

  

 Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

 We build the technology that empowers thousands of frontline peers — trainers, center managers, housekeeping staff, and gym owners — and gives central governance teams real\-time visibility into what's happening on the ground. Think IoT sensors that measure center health, vision\-tech that analyzes CCTV feeds to flag experience issues without human intervention, and workflow automation systems that orchestrate actions across the organization before a single member notices a problem.
 



  





 This is high\-impact, high\-visibility work. The products you build will be used by thousands of Cult.fit employees daily and will directly protect the workout experience of millions of members.
 



  





 We are looking for a Product Manager 2 to own and advance the operations excellence charter. You will be the connective tissue between frontline operations, central governance, process design, engineering, analytics, and UX — translating on\-ground realities into scalable, intuitive technology solutions. You will work with ambiguous, complex operational problems and drive them to crisp, well\-defined product solutions with measurable impact.

* 3\+ years of experience in product management, ideally within consumer or enterprise applications where operational complexity meets user empathy.

**About this role**


Job Description
At BlackRock, technology is central to our mission, and our team continues to drive innovation across the industry. Here, you’ll experience a collaborative environment where teamwork happens across departments, regions, and specialties. This position is within Preqin, a part of BlackRock that plays an essential role in transforming private markets data and technology for clients worldwide. Preqin’s efforts enhance our Aladdin platform to provide comprehensive investment solutions.


The Preqin Enterprise Data Solutions team manages the delivery of Preqin data to enterprise clients by developing APIs, data feeds, integrations (such as Snowflake and DataBricks), and custom tools like Excel plugins. The team operates internationally, with members located in London, Bangalore, and New York City.


As an Associate, Software Engineer on the Enterprise Data Solutions data team, you’ll join an engineering pod responsible for third\-party integrations, data feeds, APIs, and incorporating Preqin data into the BlackRock Enterprise Data Platform. Your work will focus on building robust, scalable systems that align with business objectives. You’ll deliver high\-quality solutions by applying strong data expertise, product insight, and effective communication skills. Collaboration with other engineers, product managers, and data owners will be key as you help design, develop, and launch new features and influence our technical strategy.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Overview**
 Emmes Group: Building a better future for us all.
   

  

 Emmes Group is transforming the future of clinical research, bringing the promise of new medical discovery closer within reach for patients. Emmes Group was founded as Emmes more than 47 years ago, becoming one of the primary clinical research providers to the US government before expanding into public\-private partnerships and commercial biopharma. Emmes has built industry leading capabilities in cell and gene therapy, vaccines and infectious diseases, ophthalmology, rare diseases, and neuroscience.
   

  

 We believe the work we do will have a direct impact on patients’ lives and act accordingly. We strive to build a collaborative culture at the intersection of being a performance and people driven company. We’re looking for talented professionals eager to help advance clinical research as we work to embed innovation into the fabric of our company. If you share our motivations and passion in research, come join us!
   

  

**Primary Purpose**
 The Product Owner is responsible for defining and prioritizing the product backlog and ensuring the delivery of product increments that meet the desired outcomes. They collaborate closely with the development team and stakeholders to ensure alignment with business goals. The Product Owner supports the implementation of strategic objectives set by Software Development leaders and plays a key role in maximizing the product's value.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and prioritize the product backlog based on stakeholder feedback, business value, and strategic goals.
* Develop detailed user stories and acceptance criteria for product requirements, ensuring clarity and completeness to guide the development team in creating valuable features that meet end\-user needs.
* Collaborate proactively with the development team to ensure a shared understanding and alignment of product goals and requirements. Act as the voice of the customer, providing insights and guidance to the team throughout the development process.
* Plan and manage product increments and releases strategically, balancing team capacity, technical dependencies, and business priorities to deliver maximum value within set timelines.
* Facilitate product demos and reviews with internal and external stakeholders.
* Actively participate in agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, and retrospectives. Use these meetings to foster communication, identify challenges, and drive continuous improvement within the team.
* Provide clear, actionable guidance and clarification on product requirements to the development team, ensuring that all team members understand the 'why' behind each feature and how it contributes to the overall product vision.
* Act as a liaison between stakeholders and the development team to ensure effective communication and collaboration.
* Assist with secondary tasks such as communication, advertising, and the development of training materials and/or user guides as needed.
* Evangelize the product within and outside the organization.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a public health, clinical, science, technology, or related discipline.
* Incumbent typically will possess at least 5 years of experience working as part of a software development or implementation team in any role, 2 of which must be as a product manager or equivalent role. Years of experience requirements are not cumulative.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Experience with data reporting and analytics.
* Knowledge of key concepts related to software product management is required.
* Supervisory experience over other Product Managers is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Self\-motivated, proactive and detail oriented.
* Experience working in a Scrum team is preferred.
* CSPO and/or CSM certification is preferred.
* Experience with drawing tools and UX design is preferred.
* Experience working in a clinical research or health care domain is preferred.
* Experience conducting software demos and marketing presentations is preferred.
* A degree in public health, science, or computer related field is preferred.
* Working knowledge of browser debugging tools is preferred.


**CONNECT WITH US!**
*Follow us on Twitter \- @EmmesCRO*
*Find us on LinkedIn \- Emmes*

 This role offers a rare opportunity to shape how HR shows up for every employee, every day. As the HR Service Delivery Product Owner and Knowledge Lead, you will lead askHR, UL Solutions’ global HR portal and primary entry point for HR support.
   

  

 This role exists to define, govern, and evolve the enterprise HR service delivery experience, acting as the single accountable owner for askHR as a global platform and knowledge ecosystem supporting more than 15,000 employees.
   

  

 You will directly influence how employees access HR services at scale, with measurable impact on HR efficiency, risk reduction, service quality, and employee confidence in HR support.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**HRSD Product Owner, platform and digital experience**
* Own the enterprise HR service delivery experience end to end, with accountability for design, usability, scalability, and performance across askHR, cases, workflows, journeys, and automation.
* Set and manage the HRSD roadmap, making enterprise level prioritisation decisions that balance employee experience, HR capacity, technical debt, and risk.

jobs.description:
**A career that’s the whole package!**
 At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.
   

  

**Conga** 
 lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Senior Technical Product Owner
   

  

**Locations:** 
 Bangalore, India
   

  

**Reports to** 
 : VP of Product Management
   

  

**A quick snapshot…**
 This role sits at the intersection of product and engineering. As a Senior Technical Product Owner, you will be embedded with Conga’s India\-based engineering teams for Conga Composer and Conga Sign, ensuring the backlog is always refined, requirements are technically sound, and the team has a clear path to delivery. You’ll work in close partnership with the Composer and Sign product managers, translating strategy into well\-scoped, executable work.
   

  

**Why it’s a big deal…**
 Composer and Sign are core products at Conga with a long track record of enterprise customer success and an exciting roadmap ahead. These are products used by thousands of businesses globally and central to Conga’s product strategy and revenue.
   

  

 The engineering teams building these products are talented and execution\-oriented. What they need is a TPO who keeps them unblocked, well\-informed, and focused on the right problems. If you are energized by getting requirements right, by being the connective tissue between strategy and delivery, and by earning the trust of both product and engineering, then this is an ideal role.
   

  

**Are you the person we’re looking for?**
**A proven product owner.** 
 You have 5\+ years of experience as a Product Owner or Technical PM in a B2B SaaS environment. You’ve written epics and user stories that engineering teams can execute without constant clarification and you take pride in getting requirements right the first time.
   

  

**Technically fluent.** 
 REST APIs are not a mystery to you. You understand how APIs are designed, documented, and consumed in enterprise software integrations, and you bring that knowledge into every refinement session and requirements conversation.
   

  

**An agile practitioner.** 
 You’ve worked directly with Agile/Scrum engineering teams, ideally in a distributed or offshore\-to\-HQ model.
   

  

**A clear and deliberate communicator.** 
 Whether you’re writing a user story, reviewing technical documentation, or explaining a complex integration requirement, your communication is clear, complete, and leaves no room for guesswork. You write for developers and speak to stakeholders with equal confidence.
   

  

**Education:** 
 A bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent
   

  

**Here’s What Will Give You An Edge…**
 Day to day, here’s what you’ll be doing:
   

  

* Own epic and story refinement end\-to\-end: decompose product requirements into well\-scoped, technically grounded user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
* Serve as the primary day\-to\-day interface between product management and engineering scrum teams for Composer and Sign.
* Partner with engineering leads to identify dependencies, surface technical constraints early, and maintain a healthy, prioritized backlog.
* Collaborate closely with the Technical Publications team on documentation review, providing input and suggestions that help customers succeed with the product.
* Participate in sprint ceremonies (planning, retrospectives, demos) and hold the team accountable to story quality and delivery readiness.
* Translate complex technical concepts into clear product requirements.
* Escalate blockers, risks, and scope questions to product managers and engineering managers proactively and with enough context to act on.


**And if you bring any of these, you’ll hit the ground running:** 
 Familiarity with document automation, e\-signature, or process workflow concepts is a plus. Experience with Jira and Confluence gives you an immediate head start.
   

  

**Did we pique your interest?**
 If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. We'd love to hear from you!
   

  

**Preferred Resume Format**
 We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly.
   

  

**Don’t meet every requirement for the role?**

* Acceptance Criteria Definition \& Management: Review and accept or reject work completed by the development team during sprints, ensuring that all delivered features meet the agreed\-upon acceptance criteria and deliver business value.
